definitions.title: Catalog of Classic Polar Curves
definitions.latex: r = a \pm b\cos(\theta) \; (\text{Lima\c{c}ons}), \quad r = a\cos(n\theta) \; (\text{Rose Curves}), \quad r^2 = a^2\cos(2\theta) \; (\text{Lemniscates})
definitions.statement: Standard families of polar curves categorized by trigonometric harmonic frequencies: Cardiods (a = b), Limaçons with inner loops (a < b), Dimpled limaçons (a > b), and Rose curves (n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even).
definitions.explanation: Graphing utilizes symmetry, critical radius values, and table of special angles.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Rose curve has n petals if n is odd, 2n petals if n is even.
